PuddleLane_Text_Npc0.en: I jump in every puddle. Every\nsingle one.

PuddleLane_Text_Npc1.en: Bring a coat. Or a POLIWAG.

PuddleLane_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

PuddleLane_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
